    Local simple connectivity passes from P/μ to P #

    Arrows of the cover of P/μ out of the image of an object lift to arrows of the cover of P (arrow_lift). An injective quiver map with arrow lifting and reflection of path values pulls local simple connectivity back (isCoboundaryOn_of_transfer); applied to the residue map this gives coverLocalSC_of_residue, and with the chain-bounded and no-long cases, coverLocallySimplyConnected.
